title: # Fix a failing AXF Dev Console systems check: Hub /projects folder configured The console's system…
asked: # Fix a failing AXF Dev Console systems check: Hub /projects folder configured The console's systems check reported this, and its automatic fix failed. Fix the cause, then re-check. - Check id: `routine:env-axhub-projects-dir` (service data, status warn) - What it says: AXHUB_PROJECTS_DIR isn't set - How the fix failed: - **For you:** nothing to do by hand. Point this systems-check fix at the console's Mosses chat instead of this session. `AXF_PUBLIC_URL` is stuck the same way, so both can go there together. Details: - Shared data (pending list, build queue, orchestrator) is read from the hub's /projects only when this points at the mounted volume. - env {"name": "AXHUB_PROJECTS_DIR"} How it's fixed by hand: - Mount the axhub-projects volume into the console container. - Set AXHUB_PROJECTS_DIR to its mount path (usually /projects) and redeploy. Rules: - Fix only this check. Change nothing unrelated; never delete data, volumes, containers or other people's files. - Never print, copy or commit secrets (tokens, keys, .env files, .axf-console/). - Code changes go on this worktree's branch only: commit and push the branch, never main, never merge. - When done, refresh the host report: `bash /opt/axf/deploy/console-doctor.sh --report`. - Record steps and the result on your change-log entry (the hooks do most of it; `changes.mjs step|result last …`). - You may run shell commands on the VPS (you run as root): prefer the smallest, reversible change.

result.summary: install-console.sh passes AXHUB_PROJECTS_DIR=/projects with the projects volume (commit 01e26f0c, rebased on main). Push failed: no GitHub credentials on the host (gh logged out, console GITHUB_TOKEN rejected). Live container unchanged: needs push + merge, then the auto-update rebuild applies it.
